en.sayed-ali-raza: Hasten towards the most common matter which is peculiar to every one; and that is death.

Certainly, people (who have already gone) are ahead of you while the hour (Day of Judgement) is driving you from behind. Remain light, in order that you may overtake them. Your backs are being awaited for the sake of the fronts.
Fear Allāh in the matter of His creatures and His cities because you will be questioned even about lands and beasts.
Obey Allāh and do not disobey Him. When you see virtue adopt it, and when you see vice avoid it.
